title: Equations in the Form y = mx + b Review Test
description: Write and interpret linear equations using slope and y-intercept.

questions.questionText: A line has slope 2 and y-intercept -4. Which equation represents it?
questions.explanation: In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is the y-intercept or starting value.

questions.questionText: Which equation in the form y = mx + b has m = -2/3 and b = 1?
questions.explanation: In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is the y-intercept or starting value.

questions.explanation: In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is the y-intercept or starting value.
